class.name: CgameSmokeSim
class.brief_description: Volumetric smoke and fire simulation on a small cubic 3D grid.
class.description: [CgameSmokeSim] implements Jos Stam's "Stable Fluids" (1999): semi-Lagrangian advection and pressure projection by Jacobi relaxation. Buoyancy and vorticity confinement follow Fedkiw, Stam and Jensen (2001) and GPU Gems 3 chapter 30. Fire is a simple fuel to heat and smoke reaction that ignites above [member ignition_temperature]. The grid has [member size] cells per axis. Cell centers sit at integer coordinates, the faces of the grid are open, and obstacle voxels (see [method set_obstacle]) are solid walls. Units are cells and seconds. Advection, projection and force passes are split into z slices and run on the [WorkerThreadPool]. Every pass reads the previous state and writes only the cells of its own slice, so results are deterministic. Grids smaller than 16 cells per axis run serially. The data can be uploaded to the GPU as an [ImageTexture3D] with two float channels (red is density, green is temperature) using [method to_image3d] and [method update_image3d]. This class is the native counterpart of the GDScript [code]smoke_sim.gd[/code]. [codeblock] var smoke := CgameSmokeSim.new() smoke.setup(24) smoke.add_source(Vector3i(12, 3, 12), 1.0, 1.0) func _physics_process(delta): smoke.step(delta) [/codeblock]

method.name: add_source
method.description: Adds the given amounts of smoke density, temperature, fuel and velocity to [param cell]. Does nothing if the cell is outside the grid or an obstacle.

method.name: clear
method.description: Resets velocity, density, temperature and fuel to zero. Obstacles are kept.

method.name: density_centroid
method.description: Returns the density-weighted center of mass in cell coordinates, or [constant Vector3.ZERO] if there is no smoke.

method.name: density_image_slices
method.description: Returns one [constant Image.FORMAT_RGF] image per z slice, with density in the red and temperature in the green channel. The array can be passed to [method ImageTexture3D.create].

method.name: divergence_rms
method.description: Returns the root-mean-square divergence of the velocity field over fluid cells. Zero means incompressible.

method.name: get_field
method.description: Returns a copy of [param field] for all cells. The index of cell [code](x, y, z)[/code] is given by [method index].

method.name: get_value
method.description: Returns the value of [param field] in [param cell], or [code]0.0[/code] (with an error) if the cell is outside the grid.

method.name: get_velocity
method.description: Returns the velocity stored in [param cell].

method.name: in_bounds
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param cell] lies inside the grid.

method.name: index
method.description: Returns the flat array index of the cell at [code](x, y, z)[/code], equal to [code]x + size * (y + size * z)[/code].

method.name: is_finite_state
method.description: Returns [code]false[/code] if any field contains NaN or infinity.

method.name: is_obstacle
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param cell] is inside the grid and solid.

method.name: max_temperature
method.description: Returns the highest temperature in the grid.

method.name: project
method.description: Makes the velocity field divergence free: solves the pressure Poisson equation with [member jacobi_iterations] Jacobi sweeps and subtracts the pressure gradient. Called automatically by [method step].

method.name: sample
method.description: Returns the trilinearly interpolated value of [param field] at [param position] in cell coordinates. Positions outside the grid are clamped.

method.name: set_obstacle
method.description: Marks [param cell] as a solid voxel or clears it. Solid voxels hold no velocity, density, temperature or fuel.

method.name: set_velocity
method.description: Overwrites the velocity stored in [param cell].

method.name: setup
method.description: Resets the simulation to an empty grid with [param grid_size] cells per axis (at least 4). Removes all obstacles.

method.name: step
method.description: Advances the simulation by [param dt] seconds: applies wind drag and buoyancy, vorticity confinement and combustion, projects, advects velocity, projects again, advects density, temperature and fuel, then applies cooling and decay. Does nothing if [param dt] is not positive.

method.name: to_image3d
method.description: Creates an [ImageTexture3D] with the current density (red) and temperature (green). Returns [code]null[/code] if the texture could not be created.

method.name: total_density
method.description: Returns the sum of density over the grid.

method.name: total_fuel
method.description: Returns the sum of fuel over the grid.

method.name: total_temperature
method.description: Returns the sum of temperature over the grid.

method.name: update_image3d
method.description: Refreshes an existing [param texture] in place with the current state. Cheaper than creating a new texture every frame.

members.member: Rate at which hot fuel burns, as a fraction per second.
Exponential smoke density decay rate in 1/s.
Temperature released per unit of fuel burnt.
Fuel only burns in cells at or above this temperature.
Number of Jacobi sweeps used by [method project].
Per-axis velocity limit in cells per second, applied by the force pass.
Number of cells per axis. Set through [method setup].
Smoke density released per unit of fuel burnt.
Downward acceleration per unit of smoke density (heavy gas).
Target velocity the smoke relaxes toward, in cells per second.
How fast velocity relaxes toward [member wind], in 1/s.

constants.constant: Grid size used when constructing the simulation without calling [method setup].
